high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "craftmaestros." The post features a beautifully crafted brass diya (a traditional oil lamp) with a turtle-shaped base. The diya is intricately designed with detailed patterns and textures, giving it an ornate and elegant appearance. The flame inside the diya is lit, adding a warm and inviting glow to the image. The text on the post reads: "Kurma Akhand Diya" and below that, there is a call-to-action button labeled "Shop Now," suggesting that viewers can purchase similar items through the link provided.
